askPhrases.title: Phrases that ask for a person
askPhrases.description: In each language your visitors write in. The visitor can also use the Talk to a person button.

keywords.title: Keywords that hand off
keywords.description: A visitor message containing one of these goes to a person.

failuresBeforeHandoff.title: AI failures in a row before a handoff

officeHours.title: Office hours
officeHours.description: One line per window in the time zone of business.json, for example `mon-fri 09:00-17:00`. Empty = always open.

answerFirst.title: The AI answers the message that asked for a person
answerFirst.description: Then the chat goes to a person. Off: it goes to a person at once.

showNotice.title: Tell the visitor when the chat goes to a person
showNotice.description: With the handoff notice of your widget texts (chat.handoffNotice). Outside office hours the visitor is told when staff are back.

showButton.title: Show the Talk to a person button

reassureAfterMinutes.title: Reassure after (minutes)
reassureAfterMinutes.description: From this many minutes after the handoff, the AI answers the visitor’s next messages with reassurance only, until staff reply. 0 = off.
